title: NVIDIA/IsaacCapture
abstract:
The unified framework for sim & real robot teleoperation

# Isaac Teleop **The unified framework for high-fidelity ego-centric and robotics data collection.** [ ](https://www.python.org/downloads/) [ ](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/develop) [ ](https://numpy.org/) [ ](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) --- ## Overview **Isaac Teleop**: The unified standard for high-fidelity egocentric and robot data collection. It is designed to address the data bottleneck in robot learning by streamlining device integration; standardizing high-fidelity human demo data collection; and foster device & data interoperability. ## Key Features - Unified stack for sim & real teleoperation - Standardized device interface - Flexible retargeting framework ### Teleoperation Use Cases - Currently supported use cases - Use XR headsets for gripper / tri-finger hand manipulation - Use XR headsets with gloves for dex-hand manipulation - Seated full body loco-manipulation (Homie) - Tracking based full body loco-manipulation with GR00T-WholeBodyControl (SONIC) - Egocentric data collection (aka “no-robot”) - Upcoming use cases - Teleoperate using only non-XR devices (e.g. gamepad, Gello, haply, etc.) - Teleoperate cloud based robotics simulations - Remote teleoperation with camera streaming to the desktop - Remote teleoperation with immersive camera streaming to XR headsets ## Quick Start ### Documentation Our [documentation page](https://nvidia.github.io/IsaacCapture) provides everything you need to get started, including detailed tutorials and step-by-step guides. Follow these links to learn more: - [Architecture](https://nvidia.github.io/IsaacCapture/main/overview/architecture.html) - [Quick installation steps](https://nvidia.github.io/IsaacCapture/main/getting_started/quick_start.html) - [How to build from source](https://nvidia.github.io/IsaacCapture/main/getting_started/build_from_source.html) ### Install & Run Isaac Lab Isaac Teleop is design to work side by side with [NVIDIA Isaac Lab](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab) starting

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：NVIDIA 提出的 Isaac Teleop（IsaacCapture）统一遥操作框架，通过标准化的设备接口与灵活的重定向（retargeting）模块，把 XR 头显、手套、Gr00T-WholeBodyControl(SONIC)、Homie 等不同输入设备统一映射到仿真与真实机器人上，并支持无机器人的第一视角（egocentric）人类数据采集。


# 一、动机

> 机器人学习面临高质量操作数据的瓶颈：采集设备接口不统一、人类演示数据缺乏标准化采集流程、设备与数据之间互操作性差，导致真实与仿真遥操作各自为政、数据难以复用。


# 二、方法

> NVIDIA 提出的 Isaac Teleop（IsaacCapture）统一遥操作框架，通过标准化的设备接口与灵活的重定向（retargeting）模块，把 XR 头显、手套、Gr00T-WholeBodyControl(SONIC)、Homie 等不同输入设备统一映射到仿真与真实机器人上，并支持无机器人的第一视角（egocentric）人类数据采集。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 目前为工程框架型发布，摘要未给出量化指标：已支持 5 类用例（XR 头显夹爪/三指手操作、XR+手套灵巧手、坐姿全身 loco-manipulation（Homie）、基于 GR00T-WholeBodyControl 的全身 loco-manipulation（SONIC）、无机器人 egocentric 数据采集），并规划 4 类后续用例（纯非 XR 设备如 gamepad/Gello/haply、云端仿真遥操作、桌面远程遥操作、XR 沉浸式远程遥操作），与 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 配套使用。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：仓库/文档性质的系统发布，缺少定量评测、数据质量指标与跨本体迁移效果的实验验证，且强依赖 NVIDIA Isaac 生态与 XR 硬件，非 XR 设备与云端遥操作尚在规划中。启发：其“统一设备接口 + 可插拔重定向”的抽象，是把人类第一视角演示数据规模化喂给 VLA/机器人策略的一条实用路径，可作为具身数据采集流水线的工程参考。
